title: Streaming-Mode
description: For youtubers / Streamers, Hides / changes username, hides coordinates, hides bedrock, this is only clientsided Has a gui, Overlay to see that its on, you can change the text when using coordinates in gui or in the commands.
body:
**Main Features**

**Coordinate Hiding**: Streamer Mode hides the coordinates that you see in the game. This means people watching your stream cannot see where you are or where your base is.

**Ui Protection**: Streamer Mode also helps protect you from sharing private information. It does this by changing the way the chat and other parts of the game look.

**Bedrock Camouflage**: When you use Streamer Mode it makes the bedrock in the game look like deepslate. This helps keep people from knowing how deep you are in the game.

**Rendering Tweaks**: Streamer Mode makes some changes to how the game looks so you can stream safely.

**Client-Side** You do not need to install Streamer Mode on the server to use it. This means you can use Streamer Mode with servers.

**Fabric-Based**: Streamer Mode is made for the Fabric mod loader. This means it works with versions of Minecraft that use Fabric. [which includes 26.1.1+]


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Overall Streamer Mode is, about keeping your Streamer Mode information private and making your stream look cleaner. It does this without changing the way you play Minecraft with Streamer Mode.

</details>
